data.name: Kiara
data.gender_notes: Kiara is used as a female name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Italian chiaro, 'bright, clear', or from the Irish ciar, 'dark'. Its root is Italian chiaro. A modern popular name. Kiara is a Italian name meaning “Dark; (also) bright, clear”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses. Note: this meaning has not been independently verified against a classical lexicon or primary source and is flagged for source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Kiara expresses “Dark; (also) bright, clear”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Italian chiaro, 'bright, clear', or from the Irish ciar, 'dark'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kiara total 22, reducing to 4. Number 4 is associated with discipline, order and steady effort.
